Management of hyperglycaemic emergencies Hyperglycaemic emergencies should be managed in hospital by correction of dehydration and electrolyte disbalance and administration of insulin. •• Refer to hospital all patients with suspected DKA or HHS. (DKA or HHS should be suspected in every ill patient with hyperglycaemia.) •• Correction of dehydration is the critical first step for transport. [C1]
